resolutions.fix: Fixed as the invariant, not as a third call site, because hand-placing the third is how the second was forgotten. Every place the executor rebinds `steps` was enumerated — there were three — and all three now splice through one nested `adopt(prefix, new_steps)` that lints and returns either the spliced plan or the gap. The caller still owns what a refusal MEANS: before execution it re-plans, mid-run it ends the run failure:task, because the drill-down WAS the replan and there is nothing left to re-plan with. A fourth adoption point cannot be added without a lint. The first plan is not spliced into anything and is linted where it lands; the docstring says so rather than overclaiming.
resolutions.green_after: failure:task naming the gap; the reviewer's probe no longer reaches success.
resolutions.assertion_shape: Structural, per the R13 lesson: trace_actions [navigate, extract_all, observe] pins that the run got as far as the observation and stopped there, replans: 0 that the refused plan was never counted as progress. A reason-string assertion would have passed on any of the drill-down's four refusal exits.
